objective: Qualify the existing upstream descriptor-tactic patch on H100: matched public execution, native query elimination, numerical/graph correctness and actual SGLang startup/v1 persistence.

source_arms.baseline: FlashInfer v0.7.2 release source, explicitly JIT built
source_arms.candidate: Exact original PR6148 diff at14c5c67a1eb9ad3a608b8d3da3bf6d8924037c5c applied cleanly to v0.7.2; not the full PR branch head
source_arms.packaging: Copy the pinned image package/vendors into isolated per-arm node-local directories, validate all seven original runtime source hashes, apply exact six source replacements plus doc-only engine diff, and validate all seven resulting hashes.
source_arms.native_loading: Explicit JitSpec.build then load for both arms; identical one-time module adapter, separate workspaces. Record library/build.ninja hashes and exports. Installed AOT providers cannot substitute for the rebuilt GEMM module.

execution_commit_rule: Execute a clean committed SGLang checkout containing this plan and diagnostics. Record its exact SHA and all source hashes per attempt; all primary comparison workers use one frozen revision.

workload.inputs: same seeded FP8 e4m3fn input bytes and unit FP32 dequantization scales per paired trial; BF16 output
workload.explicit_match: Each candidate uses the exact64-byte descriptor enumerated for ordinal0 by its same-seed baseline reference; verify native actual descriptor use, not fallback.
workload.persistence: existing v1 JSON, managed stores disabled in SGLang wrapper

protocol.qualification: baseline reference workers atseeds17/18/19 plus candidate17, two samples, same warmup/calibration; all must pass before primary
protocol.primary_instrumentation: none; no native preload, profiler or Python timing hooks
protocol.observations: one separate seed17 worker per arm; native first-explicit/warm/capture/replay counts and algorithm descriptors plus separate CPU/CUDA traces
protocol.lifecycle: fresh cold then fresh warm per pair, real startup wrapper and actual v1 files; preserve natural winner and independently persist/reload matched explicit tactic; prohibit warm/post-startup profiling
protocol.upstream_tests: 19 exact upstream cases:14 serialization/persistence and5 FP8[cublas] GPU cases; dedicated bootstrap with exact source helpers, no upstream global conftest/plugin environment; require no skips
protocol.compilation_caches: shared within each arm only; initial module build, candidate enumeration and setup excluded from runtime measurements

acceptance: Exact image/GPU/package/source/hash and clean execution-commit provenance passes.
Both rebuilt native libraries expose their arm's distinct APIs and are the loaded JIT paths; retain compiler/build provenance.
All qualification and primary workers pass with matched input bytes and exact paired algorithm descriptors.
All public eager and poisoned/changed/restored-input graph numerical checks pass; cache hits and descriptor used=1 are observed outside timed windows.
All primary timing blocks have15 finite positive samples,500ms warmup and20ms calibrated batches; raw normalization is consistent.
Candidate warmed explicit calls avoid both repeated heuristic enumeration and AlgoCheck; actual descriptor use=1 prevents accepting cached fallback. Default behavior is recorded separately.
Fresh warm startup and bare/capture consume persisted natural and forced explicit winners with identical cache hashes and zero profiling attempts.
Native/CUDA activity establishes observed algorithm/launch correspondence; differences are reported, not silently treated as matched performance.
All19 selected upstream cases pass without skips, or retain and classify exact failures and pending coverage.
analysis: Use three paired worker-median ratios per choice and execution mode; do not pool45samples into independent trials.
Compare candidate explicit versus baseline explicit, candidate default versus baseline default, and within-arm explicit/default controls.
Separate natural startup selection and persistence from forced matched-algorithm latency; no startup-time optimization claim.
Instrumented native/Python host spans are diagnostic only and are not summed or substituted for clean timings.
This is the exact patch over0.7.2 on H100, not an evaluation of the entire PR head, other architectures, full models or all BF16 changes.
Record failures/retries and partial findings without exclusions; explicit policy and managed-store migration remain outside scope.

publication.record: all raw logs/cache/native traces, exact source inputs, source/build provenance, independent analysis and checksums; narrative stays in the single existing working record
